label: KV — Airplane Systems and Limitations · Set 4

slides.n:
DO:
Time: 2:00 total (KV 0:50, Briefing 1:10; AQPM Table 5.1.3).
Start in the CQMT2.1 Briefing/Debriefing deck with the intro slides: About Today (including document verification, FOM 3.1) and Flow of the Day.
At the deck's KV slide, open the Preflight Pictorial Visual Inspection KV and one Airplane Systems and Limitations set (1 to 5), and complete them in either order (KV 0:50 for both parts).
When both parts are complete, return to the CQMT2.1 deck and complete the briefing (Briefing 1:10).

NOTE: If one crewmember is unsatisfactory, the remaining crewmember completes training per the crew pairing procedures found in AQPM chapter 1, Crew Scheduling and Pairing Policy (AQPM 4.3).

Time to Work Through This PPT Deck: ~50 minutes, shared with the Preflight Pictorial Visual Inspection KV (KV 0:50, AQPM Table 5.1.3).
Sequence: CQMT2.1 deck intro slides first (About Today, Flow of the Day); then this file and the Preflight Pictorial Visual Inspection KV, in either order; then return to the CQMT2.1 deck and complete the briefing (Briefing 1:10).
